name: Project Big Hat
source:
In Project Big Hat, you play as Sydney Raine, a journalist tasked with investigating a disappearance in a block of flats. A man seems to have vanished off the face of the earth while living at the Washburne apartments; a 19th Century apartment building owned by an eccentric philanthropist. 
[Edited From[url=https://lazyplague.itch.io/project-big-hat] itch.io[/url]]
